title: an stdio entry relying on PLUGIN_ROOT and PLUGIN_DATA loads
rationale: The configuration a client must be able to launch. This fixture asserts the entry is accepted, which is the part the load report can see.
quote: Clients that launch plugin subprocesses (i.e., stdio MCP servers) MUST provide `PLUGIN_ROOT` and `PLUGIN_DATA` in each subprocess environment.
observabilityNote: Whether the two variables actually reach the subprocess environment is not visible in a load report. Test that in the client's own suite.
